notes: Public data sources used by MedRadar. Everything here is free and requires no credentials. openFDA without an API key is limited to 240 requests/minute and 1,000/day per IP, which is why every collector caches aggressively under data/cache/.

clinicaltrials_gov.note: v2 API, no key, results are posted within 21 days of first enrollment for many trials.

sec_edgar.note: Fair-access policy: identify yourself with a User-Agent and stay below 10 requests/second.

nmpa.note: Probed on 2026-10-31: https://www.nmpa.gov.cn returns HTTP 412 and www.cmde.org.cn returns 202 (JavaScript challenge). MedRadar therefore does NOT scrape NMPA directly. Instead `medradar/nmpa.py` supports (a) a user-exported CSV, (b) a clearly-labelled demo seed, and (c) an HTTP adapter that is off by default. The China-gap metric reports data_status honestly when no CN data is loaded.
